en.headline: Government proposes bilingual price lists for private medical facilities
en.dek: The Health Bureau plans to submit regulations by year-end requiring fixed prices or ranges and pre-admission budget estimates for hospitals, with measures for private hospitals starting as early as August 2027.
body: The Health Bureau has submitted a paper to the Legislative Council outlining plans to improve price transparency at private medical institutions through subsidiary legislation, according to reports citing the document.

Under the proposals, all licensed private medical facilities would need to provide bilingual Chinese and English price lists in a specified format, listing all chargeable items by category such as wards, operating theatres, drugs or consumables, generally as fixed prices or ranges, for example 300 dollars each time or 300 to 500 dollars.

Licensed private hospitals would additionally be required to provide service cost estimates before admission for specified treatments and procedures. If the final charge exceeds the estimate by 20 per cent or more for cases with a fixed budget amount, the hospital must give a written explanation.

The Bureau aims to submit the regulations by the end of this year and draw up a code of practice, with phased implementation from the second half of next year. Measures applying to private hospitals could take effect as early as August 2027, while those for day procedure centres and clinics would follow later. Violations could lead to fines of up to 100,000 dollars for private hospitals and 25,000 dollars for day centres and clinics.

zh.headline: 政府擬規定私營醫療機構提供中英雙語價目表
zh.dek: 醫務衛生局計劃年底向立法會提交規例，要求列出固定價格或價格範圍，私家醫院須提供入院前費用預算，措施最早明年8月起適用於私家醫院。
body: 醫務衛生局向立法會提交文件，交代擬透過附屬法例提高私營醫療機構收費透明度的安排，報道引述文件內容指出。
建議規定所有持牌私營醫療機構須按指明格式提供中英雙語價目表，按病房、手術室或醫療程序房間、藥物或消耗品等類別列出所有收費項目、服務描述及價目，一般以固定價格或價格範圍表述，例如每次300元或300元至500元。
持牌私家醫院另須就指明治療及程序，在病人入院前提供服務費用預算。若以固定金額列明預算的個案，最終收費超出預算20%或以上，醫院須向病人提供書面解釋。
局方目標今年年底提交規例並擬訂實務守則，明年下半年起分階段落實。適用於私家醫院的措施最早可於明年8月生效，日間醫療中心及診所則稍後實施。違反規定可被定罪罰款，私家醫院最高10萬元，日間中心及診所最高2.5萬元。
